show: The Skeptics' Guide to the Universe

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: A live-stage discussion exploring traffic in Los Angeles, string theory, and space probes.
kurzfassung: The hosts record live from Los Angeles, debating local traffic, food, and culture before discussing historical science hype including string theory and the hydrogen economy. They also review the history of the weight-loss drug fen-phen and the Segway personal transporter. Finally, guest Brian Wecht hosts a themed science-or-fiction game about mathematics and higher spatial dimensions.
stichpunkte: The hosts discuss the realities of living in Los Angeles, comparing its traffic and food scene favorably to New York.
A visit to the California Science Center to view the space shuttle Endeavour full stack inspires awe.
Breakthrough Starshot aimed to send tiny laser-driven probes to Proxima Centauri, but faces severe engineering and financial hurdles.
String theory evolved from a hyped theory of everything into a versatile mathematical tool within theoretical physics.
The 1990s weight-loss combination fen-phen was pulled from the market after causing serious heart valve damage.
The hydrogen economy failed to materialize due to massive infrastructure hurdles, inefficiency, and reliance on fossil fuels for production.
The Segway failed as a mass-transportation revolution because it lacked a clear use case, faced infrastructure bans, and suffered from high costs.
Elon Musk's repeated predictions of crewed missions and cities on Mars have consistently missed their deadlines due to extreme technical challenges like radiation.

kapitel.titel: Whatever Happened to the Hydrogen Economy?
Whatever Happened to Going to Mars?

clips.hook: Sending a probe to the nearest star
clips.text: A proposed interstellar mission intended to accelerate an ultra-lightweight probe to a fraction of the speed of light using powerful lasers.
The staggering peak popularity of a popular 1990s weight-loss combination before health concerns led to its removal.

clips.hook: Less than one percent green hydrogen
clips.text: The overwhelming majority of industrial hydrogen originates from fossil fuels rather than renewable energy sources.

clips.hook: Only fourteen thousand Segways ever sold
clips.text: The commercial failure of a personal transporter that was once predicted to surpass the internet in cultural impact.

clips.hook: Math, physics, and higher spatial dimensions
clips.text: An introduction to a specialized trivia game focused on complex geometry and theoretical physics concepts.

beschreibung: Live from LA with guests Andrea Jones Rooy and Brian Wecht; Living in LA; What Ever Happened To: Breakthrough Starshot, Fen-phen, The Coming Hydrogen Economy, String Theory, The Segway, Going to Mars; Science or Fiction
